'''Hrvatski nogometni klub Gorica''' ({{langx|en|Croatian Football Club Gorica}}), commonly referred to as '''HNK Gorica''', is a Croatian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Velika Gorica]], located just south of the Croatian capital [[Zagreb]]. They compete in the [[Croatian Football League]] (HNL), the top tier of [[Croatian football league system|Croatian football]]. They play their home matches at [[Gradski stadion Velika Gorica]], which has a capacity of 8,000. They won the [[2010–11 Croatian Second Football League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sportcom.hr/sport/nogomet/domaci-nogomet/maxtv-prva-liga/hoo-donio-odluku-nogometni-klub-gorica-je-morao-igrati-maxtv-prvu-ligu|title=NK Gorica morao igrati MAXtv Prvu ligu!|date=30 March 2012|publisher=Sportcom.hr|access-date=30 May 2019|archive-date=30 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190530033217/http://www.sportcom.hr/sport/nogomet/domaci-nogomet/maxtv-prva-liga/hoo-donio-odluku-nogometni-klub-gorica-je-morao-igrati-maxtv-prvu-ligu|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://cityportal.hr/hnk-gorica-je-na-sceni-a-nk-radnik-se-ne-zaboravlja/|title=HNK Gorica je na sceni a NK Radnik se ne zaboravlja|date=28 December 2016|publisher=cityportal.hr|first=Mato|last=Paviša|access-date=29 May 2019|archive-date=29 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190529235741/http://cityportal.hr/hnk-gorica-je-na-sceni-a-nk-radnik-se-ne-zaboravlja/|url-status=live}}</ref>"}}
